q: The unit of angular velocity is _____. 2024,2025,2026
e: Angular velocity is defined as the rate of change of angular displacement per unit time, making its SI unit radian per second.

q: Some of the examples of rotational motion are _____. 2024,2025,2026
a: motion of the earth around the sun
e: Rotational motion occurs when an object spins about an axis passing through its own body, such as fan blades.

q: In uniform circular motion, the magnitude of _____ remains constant. 2024,2025,2026
e: In uniform circular motion, speed (the magnitude of velocity) stays constant while its direction constantly changes.

q: Centripetal acceleration is present in _____ circular motion. 2024,2025,2026
e: Centripetal acceleration is always present in any circular motion to continuously redirect the velocity vector toward the center.

q: One revolution per minute is about _____. 2024,2025,2026
e: Converting 1 rpm to rad/s yields (2π / 60) rad/s ≈ 0.105 rad/s.

q: The motion of the blades of a fan is _____ motion. 2024,2025,2026
e: Fan blades turn around a fixed central axis, which is the defining characteristic of rotational motion.

q: The direction of the velocity vector of an object in uniform circular motion _____ 2024,2025,2026
e: The velocity vector is always tangent to the circular path, so its direction changes continuously at every point.

q: In rotational motion under constant angular acceleration, which of the following quantities changes uniformly over time? 2024,2025,2026
e: Constant angular acceleration means the rate of change of angular velocity is constant, so angular velocity increases or decreases uniformly.

q: Analogue of mass in rotational motion is _____. 2024,2025,2026
e: Moment of inertia represents rotational inertia, acting as the exact rotational counterpart to linear mass.

q: If the angular velocity ω is increasing, the angular acceleration α is _____. 2024,2025,2026
e: When rotational speed increases, angular acceleration acts in the direction of angular velocity, making it positive.
